issue.title: record-card e2e markdown-neutral case races Ledger's auto bob projects sync
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-oj.5.1.4 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-oj.5.1 land agent. Not caused by the group-rail epic.

In one run of `scripts/obsidian-record-card-e2e.cjs` (report file:explicit:39b045d399ea333ad0ffd879), the case `render-fold-collapse-and-navigation-are-markdown-neutral` failed. The scratch vault got the commit `projects: sync lifecycles and catalogs (1 notes)`, which added a `## Projects` catalog to body.md inside the case's passive window, right after the suite edited a record's type/parent. Ledger's fingerprint-driven auto `bob projects sync` raced the Markdown-neutral assertion. Reruns on the same tree and on base 7b44b29 passed 180/180.

Fix: pre-seed the fixture's catalog, or hold projects auto-sync during the passive window, so the byte-neutral check only sees the card's own writes.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 failure in 3+ runs on the same group-rail tree; reruns and pre-epic base 7b44b29 passed 180/180. Cause seen in the scratch vault git log: an auto 'projects: sync lifecycles and catalogs' commit inside the passive window.

issue.creation_reason: The group-rail rail-proof phase saw a real-Obsidian record-card e2e case fail once because an automatic projects sync wrote into the scratch vault during its byte-neutral window.
